intro: Thurman's Remains are the corporeal remnants of Thurman Agamand, recovered from the family's ruined mills in northern Tirisfal Glades. Once a wealthy mill owner who persuaded his workers to stand against the Scourge, Thurman succumbed to the Plague and wanders his former estate as an undead thrall.

p: Before the Third War, the Agamand family stood as the most prosperous landowners in Tirisfal Glades, operating extensive mills and employing dozens of local workers. When the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, Thurman Agamand and his kin fortified their estate rather than fleeing. Convinced that their wealth and fortified mills could weather the onslaught, they persuaded their loyal laborers to take up arms beside them. The defense failed utterly. The Agamands and their workers were slaughtered and transformed into mindless servants of the Lich King. Today, Coleman Farthing—a former employee risen as Forsaken—demands the destruction of his former masters, seeking Thurman's remains as proof that the foolish patriarch has paid for dooming his household.
